request.spec:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The `viewer` role is in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**Server**
- `viewer` is now accepted as a role, alongside clerk and steward (`role/Role.java`, `role/ValidateRole.java`). The existing `user_role` table already stores it, so the schema didn't change.
- A new filter, `ViewerGuard.java`, runs before every endpoint. It refuses any POST or PUT to `/api/sheets/{sheet}/…` from a viewer with a 400, before any step runs. So nothing is stored or audited, and the screen shows that form's or action's usual error. This covers adding a person or claim, the sheet's today, a statement, a hold, settings, rates, roles, claim actions, quick add, the paste box, edit and retire.
- **Bulk buttons:** bulk open and bulk settle are the only bulk endpoints the app has, and the filter lets both through. `ClaimStatusChanger` now refuses any change by a viewer, so a viewer's press comes back with 0 done, every selected claim refused, and no error. A single claim action by a viewer is also refused by this check, in case the filter is bypassed.
- **Not built:** reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date and void have no bulk buttons here, and there are no generate buttons, imports or rollovers. When one of those is added, it needs the same treatment: add its path to the filter's bulk list and refuse each item.

**Front end**
- The role form's hint and error text now mention viewer.
- I also fixed a bug the test exposed: a person's row can show errors from three separate actions (statement, hold, retire). An old refusal stayed on screen when the next action was taken, so the row showed two errors and the test failed. These actions now share a mutation key per person, and a new hook, `query/useIsLatest.ts`, shows only the latest action's error. This matches the rule that an error is removed when the next action on that row is taken.

The permission-matrix settings still accept only clerk and steward. That makes no difference, because a viewer is refused before any permission check.
